declarations.description:
Word puzzles for WebWriter: a crossword generated from a list of words and clues, or a
find-the-words puzzle. The widget owns a grid element and a clue panel; the words and clues
are entered in a drawer in edit mode, and the crossword layout is generated by
`src/model/crossword-gen.ts`. Other puzzle types can be added through the `type` property.

Keyboard: in a crossword, type letters; arrow keys move, Space changes direction, Tab and Shift+Tab
jump to the next and previous clue, Escape leaves the grid. In find-the-words, arrow keys move between
letters and Enter or Space marks the first and then the last letter of a word. Pointer and touch drag a
line over the letters of a word. The widget scales its grid with its width (300 to 2100 px) and prints
as a paper puzzle: the grid and the clues, without buttons.

Conversions: a `dl` (a word in each `dt`, its clue in the `dd`) and a `ul` or `ol` (a word in each `li`) become a
puzzle; the words export as `dl`. Files: `.csv` (word and clue columns, header optional, comma, semicolon or tab),
`.txt` (one word per line, a tab starts the clue) and `.json` (the widget's own data with the layout) import; the
same three export. A file import without layout generates the puzzle, so the words are placed anew. CSV and text
keep only words and clues: the layout and the puzzle type are dropped. A word that is already in the list is
imported once.

Signals: `progress` is the share of the puzzle the reader has solved, from 0 to 1: letters that match the answer
in a crossword, words found in find-the-words. `solved` is true when everything is solved. Neither is saved.

Styling: the text follows `--ww-text-color` and `--ww-font-family`; the focus and selection tint follows
`--ww-theme-accent-1`.

members.name: options
members.default: { type: { type: "select" as const, group: "puzzle", label: (widget: {msg: MsgFn}) => widget.msg("Puzzle Type"), options: [ { value: "crossword", label: (widget: {msg: MsgFn}) => widget.msg("Crossword") }, { value: "find-the-words", label: (widget: {msg: MsgFn}) => widget.msg("Find the words") }, ], }, }

members.name: optionGroups
members.default: { puzzle: { label: (widget: {msg: MsgFn}) => widget.msg("Puzzle"), collapsible: true, advanced: false }, }

members.name: actions
members.default: { editWords: { label: (widget: {msg: MsgFn}) => widget.msg("Edit words"), group: "puzzle", icon: "Edit", intent: "default" as const }, checkAnswers: { label: (widget: {msg: MsgFn}) => widget.msg("Check answers"), group: "puzzle", icon: "Check", intent: "default" as const }, generatePuzzle: { label: (widget: {msg: MsgFn}) => widget.msg("Generate puzzle"), group: "puzzle", confirm: (widget: {msg: MsgFn}) => widget.msg("Place the words on a new grid? The current layout is replaced."), intent: "danger" as const }, clearAnswers: { label: (widget: {msg: MsgFn}) => widget.msg("Clear answers"), group: "puzzle", confirm: (widget: {msg: MsgFn}) => widget.msg("Clear all letters and found words?"), intent: "danger" as const }, }

members.name: signals
members.default: { progress: computed(() => this.#progress.get()), solved: computed(() => this.#progress.get() >= 1), }
members.description: Published for other widgets: `progress` (0 to 1) and `solved`.

members.name: _wordsClues
members.description: The list of words grouped with their clues, direction, and word number.

members.name: _cwContext
members.description:
Current crossword context; across and clue number. Not reactive: the grid and the clue box
take it through `set-context` and update themselves.

members.name: gridW
members.description: The grid element of the puzzle.

members.name: clueInpW
members.description: The input table for words and clues (author only).

members.name: clueW
members.description: The panel element of the crossword puzzle, containing the words and clues.

members.name: focus
members.description: Moves focus into the grid, to the first cell that takes keyboard input.

members.name: generatePuzzle
members.description: Places the words of the list on a new grid again. Does nothing without words.

members.name: clearAnswers
members.description: Empties the letters the reader entered, or the words the reader found.

members.name: applyPuzzle
members.description:
Takes a parsed word list as the content of the puzzle. Words that come with a layout keep it; for all others
the puzzle is generated.

members.name: #prepare
members.description: Parses a file when the import runs and returns the function that applies it.

members.name: #words
members.description: The words that are placed or not, the way the data block keeps them.

members.name: loadDl
members.description: A list of words (a `dt` with an optional `dd`). Declines a source without a word.

members.name: toDl
members.description: The words as a `dl`: each word in a `dt`, its clue in a `dd`. Null without words.

declarations.summary: Crossword and find-the-words puzzles with a word and clue editor.
